notes.title: Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Patch 1.55.2090
notes.notes:
Jolly Friday to you, everyone! We've just put out a patch with a few fixes. See the full changelog below.

[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.55.2090 - December 14th, 2018[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented interaction with Ruins
[*]Fixed a bug that caused deleted autosaves to linger in the autosaves list
[*]Fixed issues with Discord integration when loading a local match 
[*]Added a safety fix for weapons that have been modded to have the projectile count of 0 (usually accidentally). Now they always fire at least one shot
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.55.2083 - Improved Performance and Discord Integration
notes.notes:
In the midst of heavy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/761910/Worbital/]Worbital[/url] development, we’ve managed to set aside some time for an Interplanetary update, consisting of a few game fixes. The main point of this update is improving the overall performance of the game.

Another noticeable new thing, as the title states, is the Discord integration. Now you can invite people to play Interplanetary with you through Discord. 

See the full changelog:

[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.55.2083 - December 4th, 2018[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Discord Integration
[list]
[*]Discord now shows when you're playing Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition and if you're setting up an online match. It's also possible to create invites through Discord and join the match.
[list]
[*]Note: This feature may not work properly on Ubuntu Linux, if Discord was installed through the Ubuntu Software Center. This can be fixed by downloading and re-installing Discord through the official website (https://discordapp.com/)
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed "Too Much!"-Achievement
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed players to sell a building multiple times
[*]Fixed a glitch that allowed players to sometimes build more than one instances of the same upgrade on a building
[*]Enemy building visibility percentage on Targeting View is now capped to 100%
[*]AI is no longer able to target buildings it cannot see
[*]Updated folder names and data files within ModBase.zip to reduce the chance of issues when modding the game
[/list]
[*][b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]Various Performance Improvements
[*]Added a link to Interplanetary Discord in Main Menu
[*]Removed Worbital beta link
[*]Minor Text Fixes
[*]Slightly decreased Telescope Array's Intel gain
[*]Slightly decreased Asteroid Diversion building damage
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.54.2060 - GDPR
notes.notes:
Due to the European Union GDPR regulations, Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition now offers the option to opt-out of all analytics data collection done by the game. You can opt-out and view your data from the link in the Options menu.

Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition collects non-personally identifiable gameplay data to help improve the gameplay experience.

[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.54.2060 - May 25th, 2018[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]A link to view and to opt-out the data collected by the game has been added to the General Options, to comply with the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Interplanetary Update 1.54.2030 - Repair All and Status Update
notes.notes:
Just a little patch to bring on the holiday cheer! Nothing massive, but the hero of this update is the much-requested "Repair All"-feature. 

It's something we've wanted to implement for a long time, but it was always tacked on alongside other similar features that were somewhat costly to develop. But, since Christmas is approaching, we thought what the heck, let's just make a simple, separate version of it for all to enjoy. Hope you'll like it!

In other news, we're now going full steam ahead with our new project,  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/worbital#]Worbital[/url], approaching the first playable version. As for the future Interplanetary updates, we still have some things on our internal wishlist that we'd like to get into the game. With Worbital now taking the bulk of our development time, it's hard to make concrete promises or solid timelines, but whenever we get the chance to pull some resources into Interplanetary updates, we will gladly do so. Not ready to call it quits yet! Keep the feedback coming, we'll do what we can, when we can!

Happy Holidays from TJR!

[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.54.2030 - December 19th, 2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Repair All
[list]
[*]"Repair All" is a small menu that becomes visible when at least one of your buildings has been damaged to a certain point. This menu is a one-click solution to repair all buildings that are below a certain HP threshold.
[/list]
[/list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Power Grid Disconnected Event Log Event not triggering sometimes
[*]Adjusted Coilcannon hitmarker to not overlap with the planet so often
[*]Text fixes
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.52.1979 - Halloween!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30208915/e86a31d9ba6adee17e3e86f9c6c531f1ee1be41c.png[/img]

Boo! Today on the plate: quality-of-life features, fixes, balance adjustments and the mysterious Halloween Mode... You'll have to find out about that on your own. 

Oh, and did you notice our status update about Worbital earlier this month? If not, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/650220/announcements/detail/1467469635875560196]you can see some early stuff about our newest project behind this link![/url] 

Okay, that's enough advertising, we know what you're all here for. Presenting, today's changelog. Bon appétit!

[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.52.1979 - October 26th, 2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Ruin Rebuild
[list]
[*]Ruins can now be clicked to rebuild the ruined building, along with its upgrades, with the combined cost of the building, upgrades and ruin clearing
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Building Duplication
[list]
[*]Building Window now has the option to duplicate the building. This allows you to easily build a copy of the selected building, upgrades included.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Halloween Mode
[list]
[*]Boo!
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed incorrect overall accuracy stat on end screen, when using lasers
[*]Fixed bugs in weapon sorting
[*]Fixed/expanded power line colorization and power icons depending on building types and states
[*]Made power lines visible even when the connected buildings are very close to each other
[*]Fixed missing upgrades on building icon for buildings with pre-installed upgrades
[*]Removed the ability to accidentally open the weapon upgrade popup while targeting
[*]Fixed ground targeting to select first the free weapon instead of first weapon on the list
[*]Fixed the targeting line angle number to work between -179 and 180 degrees, and reversed the positive direction to be clockwise
[*]Fixed a bug that caused ground target markers to not disappear properly
[*]Stopped resource bars from mysteriously changing their color shade
[*]Prevented the random generic avatars from repeating when adding new players to the match
[*]Fixed project duration icon turning into HP-icon on first initialization
[*]Fixed incorrect filename on the mod localizations-file, allowing players to now actually name their modded buildings
[*]Added missing fallout icons
[*]Added missing tooltips
[*]Various Fixes
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]Buffed City Barrier against Asteroid Diversion
[*]Reduced Shield Defense activation cost
[*]Reduced Floating Plant HP
[*]Reduced overall repair energy cost
[*]Redesigned Stealth upgrades to better benefit low stealth buildings
[*]AI now builds a wider variety of projects
[*]Added the ability to open City Window by double clicking on a City icon on the resource bar
[*]Added the ability to click on the icons on the Intel Meter in Ground Targeting to shuffle between enemy buildings
[*]Added mouseover tooltips for buildings, showing the exact number of HP they have left
[*]Added weapon name on the targeting reticle while targeting
[*]Added the names of the weapons next to the target markers on planet surface
[*]Predicted damage is now easier to see on the building icons in ground targeting
[*]Upgrade and Project Windows made slightly wider to allow all effects in English to fit in the description area without line breaks
[*]Added the option to manually select the keyboard layout (QWERTY, AZERTY, QWERTZ)
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.52.1913 - Online Saves, Modding Improvements and AI Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello, Interplanetarists!

Here's another bunch of various fixes, littered with a couple of pretty nice features. Among other things, this update includes two popular requests: Online Saving and fixes to the AIs targeting behavior. From now on, the inhumanely well targeted shots that the AI has been known for, are reserved for the "Impossible"-difficulty setting only.

Other noteworthy things include additional modding mechanics. You can now actually add custom buildings using pre-existing assets. Check the Modding Guide in the game's root folder for more info.

Enjoy!

[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.52.1913 - September 6th, 2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Online Saving
[list]
[*]Allows you to save an online game and continue it later. Only the original players can load a saved online game, but they can be replaced with AI or other players when re-creating the game
[/list]
[*]Improved Modding Features
[list]
[*]You can now add new buildings, upgrades, projects and such, using previously existing assets and mechanics
[*]Game Setup now has a button that allows you to quickly view the changes made to the Gameplay Data files, in comparison to the official "Enhanced"-ruleset. You can also use this to see the changes the host has made, before staring an online match
[*]A quick modding guide added to the root folder of the game
[/list]
[*]Defense Bypass Probability Icon
[list]
[*]When hovering over a defense range in ground targeting, an icon will now show the percentual probability you have for bypassing the defense
[/list]
[*]Super Weapon Limit-Option
[list]
[*]Re-implemented the Game Setup option to enable and disable the mechanic that restricts the building of super weapons to one of each type
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]AI now targets much more sensible trajectories, depending on the difficulty selection
[*]AI can no longer target destroyed or surrendered planets
[*]Event Log no longer shows the exact damage values when hitting a Shadow Building
[*]Fixed music transitions
[*]Fixed a bug that caused saving not to work when autosave amount was set to 0 in options
[*]Fixed various UI-elements to remember player specific scroll positions and Build Menu to remember expanded/collapsed categories
[*]Fixed the Nuclear Missile Fallout defense penetration upgrade
[*]Fixed Fallout Probability-mechanic
[*]Fixed "Phased Coiling"-Coilcannon upgrade to deduct one fragment instead of one projectile
[*]Fixed Tech Tree tooltips occasionally showing the wrong unlocks
[*]Various disconnect/reconnect fixes
[*]Minor Text Fixes
[*]Various Other Fixes
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Patch 1.51.1851 - Situation Report
notes.notes:
Greetings again, Interplanetarists!

For the past week we've been doing our best to fix issues in the game as soon as possible, putting out patches almost every day. By now, it seems we've been able to weed out most of the more critical issues and to add a few nice things along the way.

It’s impossible to keep up that pace forever, so the following updates will be coming out at a more manageable pace. One reason for that is that it’s more effective to work on patches without having to put them out every day, now that the most critical ones are seemingly done. The other reason is that a part of the team is taking a quick break to catch their breath after this intense marathon to finish, release and patch the game up.

The reception so far has been nothing short of amazing! Thanks to everyone playing and sending us feedback for the past week, it's been really useful and encouraging!

Without further ado, here's today's changelog:

[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Patch 1.51.1851 - August 11th, 2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Fix[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that snuck in with earlier update today, causing ruin/fallout clearing to stop after 6 times
[*]Some other small fixes
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Patch 1.51.1842 - August 11th, 2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Prevented large area-of-effect markers from clipping with the planet
[*]Fixed Power Connector colors to be less misleading
[*]Fixed event log damage tooltips to more accurately show building HP
[*]Fixed a graphical glitch on Nuclear explosion
[*]Fixed repair, sell and ruin clearing audio
[*]Fixed bug that caused players defeated by fallout, not actually being defeated (the infamous ghost planet-bug)
[*]Fixed bug that caused fallout to clear in wrong phase
[*]Rounded up some values in UI
[*]General fixes to online desync issues
[*]General performance improvements
[*]Various fixes
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Patch 1.51.1815 - August 11th, 2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Fix[/b]
[list]
[*]Hotfixed problematic debug log behaviour
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.51.1763 - Nice Little Features
notes.notes:
Another day, another patch. This time, we have some actual, small quality-of-life features for you to enjoy. Read on and enjoy!

Happy blasting!

[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Update 1.51.1763 - August 7th, 2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Building Cycling
[list]
[*]You can now cycle through buildings of the same type, similarly to cities
[/list]
[*]Building/City Window Pinning
[list]
[*]You can now click on a button on the building/city window to pin it to the current location. All the new building windows appear on the same location when pinned
[/list]
[*]Building Numbering
[list]
[*]Buildings are now automatically numbered, making them easier to keep track of
[/list]
[/list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed building ring disappearing when building (for reals, this time)
[*]Fixed weapon AOE graphics bug, showing incorrect area of effect
[*]Fixed chat autoscrolling
[*]Sending a chat message now retains focus on the input field
[*]Fixed a bug that caused city names to be doubled when playing with more than 5 cities
[*]WASD panning speed is now affected by planetary system size
[*]Fixed custom building names to be saved when saving the match
[*]AI now builds defenses
[*]Fixed ai not calculating intel upgrade efficiency
[*]Fixed some achievement triggers in online matches
[*]Fixed material gain ignoring the amount of planet material left
[*]Implemented planet material-tooltip
[*]Fixed multiple bugs in fallout mechanic generation in online mode
[*]Fixed building fallout to be generated correctly
[*]Fixed turn timer ending sounds creeping into the action phase
[*]Miscellaneous audio fixes
[/list]
[*][b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]Railgun damage slightly increased
[*]Railgun AOE slightly increased
[*]Easy AI is now slightly worse at targeting
[*]Expanded ESC-button functionality to close certain screens correctly and use cancel stack to close info popups, cancel powerlines, to do everything that Mouse 2nd button did.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Patch 1.50.1729
notes.notes:
[h1]Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition Patch 1.50.1729 - August 4th, 2017[/h1]

[u]Note:[/u] Previously saved games using the setting "Variable Orbit Angles" do not work properly after this update. Orbit angles themselves work much better now. Sorry for the inconvenience.

[list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed "Variable Orbit Angles"-option from generating impossible planetary systems (note: as a side-effect, previously saved games with "Variable Orbit Angles" do not work properly anymore)
[*]Disappearing building rings possibly fixed
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the game to start with only AI players
[*]Defenses now provide a boost to city population when the city is fully inside the defense radius
[*]MacOs now uses older OpenGL API by default to enabled Steam Overlay functionality
[*]Locked, Used and Permanently Used project slots now use proper icons
[*]Reset-button in GameSetup will now reset game setup back to its default values instead of last accepted values
[*]Removed the unused "Players Waiting" and "Players in Game" texts from the Online menus header
[*]Target clicking for missiles and lasers further improved
[*]Fixed steam invites not working properly
[/list]
[*][b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]Zoom should be faster when zooming out far
[*]Player Names should scale up better when zooming out
[*]AI is now likely to build more resources and less weapons to support a proper economy
[*]AI is now slightly more likely to use missiles and MIRVs
[*]Added the number of damage caused or received to damage event tooltips in Event Log
[*]The total population in the resources UI now updates in real time during action phase when a city is damaged
[*]Cities' Project Slots are now visible on the city indicators above resource bars
[*]Renamed save files on the OS side now change their name within the game also
[*]Added Skull Icon for Defeated Player in the Intel View and the permanent intel buttons
[*]Disabled Connect-button in City and Building Info Popup when specific building has no free Power Connector Slots
[*]Targeting lock-on now filters defeated planets
[*]Defaulted audio volumes to 10
[/list]
[/list]
